product.title: Portland Top Sights Half Day City Tour

description.text: Explore Portland's top sights on a half-day guided tour through historic districts, riverfront viewpoints, and Washington Park. The route introduces city history and culture while visiting landmarks such as Pittock Mansion and the International Rose Test Garden with a knowledgeable local guide.

highlights: Half-day overview of Portland's most visited landmarks
Visit Pittock Mansion and the International Rose Test Garden
Travel the Historic Columbia River Highway corridor into city districts
Small-group format with a local guide
Pickup available from select Portland hotels

start.description: Pickup is available at select downtown Portland hotels or a central meeting point confirmed after booking.

end.description: Returns to the original Portland pickup location.
